_meta.source: MONTAGE M Data List (montage_m_dl_H0.pdf, 'For firmware version 3.01 and later')
notes: 'number' is the preset Arp Number as used by the MIDI parameter 'Arp 1-8 Number' (Part Arpeggio block); 0 = Off.
sound_type: the PDF prints ':' (ditto) for rows sharing the Sound Type of the row above; sound_type is the resolved value, sound_type_ditto=true marks rows where it was printed as ':'.
accent/random_sfx: true where the PDF prints a marker glyph in the Accent / Random SFX column.
page: PDF page index (1-based) the row was read from.
